answer: An attacker running 171 aliases therefore needs 80 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in whisper, expire in zenith, and canyon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1465 identities would post 736 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
